run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend-proxy since 2026-11-17T09:30:52Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/frontend-proxy is a symptom of a broken call path into the ad tier. frontend-proxy's error-span rate sat at a background 0.0037–0.0185/s through 09:31:52 and then jumped to 0.837/s at 09:33:52, rising to 1.958/s at 09:39:52; its errors are 503s on operation 'ingress' (484.16 error spans in 09:32–09:42) always paired with failures on 'router frontend egress' (481.98), i.e. its own upstream path rather than an internal proxy fault. The dependency behind it is the ad service: frontend's error spans are confined to GET /api/data, 'executing api route (pages) /api/data', the client span grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds and tcp.connect, and ad's span throughput fell from 176–278 spans/min to exactly 0 from 09:31 through 09:40 while frontend and frontend-proxy kept normal volume. On the ad side, container ad-554b849958-fcl25/ad was OOMKilled (exit 137) at 09:30:21Z and restarted in place at 09:30:22Z (restartCount 1), and ad's readable log stream ends at 09:30:18.8Z. During the same window, chaos-mesh Schedule otel-demo-ad-jvm-chaos repeatedly spawned JVMChaos experiments whose Applied/Recovered events name otel-demo/ad-554b849958-fcl25/ad, from 09:29:56Z onwards roughly every minute to 09:38:53Z. Service/Endpoint configuration for ad and the absence of NetworkPolicies were checked and are not the cause; the pod was not recreated by a controller. The injected JVM fault type could not be read (the JVMChaos/Schedule custom resources are not readable here), ad's post-restart logs and incident-window traces were not obtainable, so the exact in-JVM mechanism and the causal link from the injections to the OOMKill and to ad's continued silence remain hypotheses; the cause therefore rests on events alone and the conclusion is partial.

claims.text: frontend-proxy's error-span rate was low and stable (0.0037–0.0185 per second) through 09:31:52, then rose to 0.837/s at 09:33:52, 1.537/s at 09:35:52, 1.622/s at 09:37:52, 1.958/s at 09:39:52 and 1.270/s at 09:41:52 (5-minute rate windows).

In the 09:32:00–09:42:06 slice, frontend-proxy produced 484.16 error spans on operation 'ingress' and 481.98 on operation 'router frontend egress'; over the whole authorized window the service counted 1041.78 STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans against 46967.63 spans carrying no error status (STATUS_CODE_UNSET).

frontend's error spans in 09:32:00–09:42:06 are limited to the ad path: GET /api/data 477.64, 'executing api route (pages) /api/data' 477.64, grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds 477.64, GET 477.64 and tcp.connect 8.68, while its non-error GET /api/data spans collapsed from ~110 per 120s to 5.33 per 120s; cart, checkout, products, recommendations and ProductCatalogService/GetProduct operations show 0 error spans in that slice.

ad stopped emitting spans: 278, 236, 236, 216 and 176 spans/min in the 60s buckets ending 09:26:00–09:30:00, then exactly 0 at every bucket ending 09:31:00 through 09:40:00, while frontend (5278–6896 spans/min) and frontend-proxy (2558–2952 spans/min) continued at normal volume.

In the metric point ending 09:32:52 (a 120s window spanning the onset), ad's operations oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, getAdsByCategory, getRandomAds and the flagd ResolveBoolean spans all read 0, while frontend's grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds carried 81.33 error spans and its tcp.connect carried 12 error spans.

Pod ad-554b849958-fcl25 (phase Running, Ready condition True, pod start 2026-11-17T08:53:17Z) has container 'ad' with restartCount 1, lastState.terminated reason OOMKilled, exitCode 137, finishedAt 2026-11-17T09:30:21Z, and current state running startedAt 2026-11-17T09:30:22Z.

Chaos-mesh events show child objects named otel-demo-ad-jvm-chaos-* logging 'Applied' with message 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/ad-554b849958-fcl25/ad' at 09:29:56Z, 09:30:56Z, 09:32:01Z, 09:32:55Z, 09:33:52Z, 09:34:51Z, 09:36:04Z, 09:37:06Z and 09:38:02Z, each followed by TimeUp and 'Successfully recover chaos for otel-demo/ad-554b849958-fcl25/ad', with the parent object otel-demo-ad-jvm-chaos logging Spawned/Forbid for those children roughly every 60s from 09:29:46Z to 09:38:53Z.

Cluster event grouping across all namespaces lists kind Schedule in namespace chaos-mesh with reasons Spawned (10), Forbid (13) and Updated (10), and kind JVMChaos in namespace chaos-mesh with Applied (9), Started (10), Recovered (9) and TimeUp (9) inside the authorized window; the only fault-injecting objects observed targeting the ad pod are these chaos-mesh Schedule/JVMChaos objects.

The ad Service is a ClusterIP with selector opentelemetry.io/name=ad forwarding port 8080 to targetPort 8080, and Endpoints 'ad' holds one address 100.96.4.112:8080 with targetRef Pod ad-554b849958-fcl25 in otel-demo.
The cluster has no NetworkPolicy objects (the listing returned an empty array over all namespaces).

The ad Deployment has replicas 1 and availableReplicas 1; its container requests 225Mi memory / 10m CPU with limits 450Mi memory / 50m CPU, and runs image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad with OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT http://otel-collector:4318, FLAGD_HOST=flagd and AD_PORT=8080.

ad's readable container log lines end at 2026-11-17T09:30:18.817405901Z with routine request lines ('no baggage found in context', 'Targeted ad request received for [...]', 'Non-targeted ad request received, preparing random response.'), and a filter for error/exception/OutOfMemory/fatal/panic/fail matched 0 of the 2744 lines read for the current instance.

All 21 pods in namespace otel-demo were phase Running with ready containers at query time; only ad-554b849958-fcl25 and fraud-detection-9fb7d885b-wbm7f showed a restartCount of 1, and frontend-675fd7b5c5-cmhqq and frontend-proxy-6b4d584985-whhck showed restartCount 0.

In the 09:32:00–09:42:06 slice the per-service error-span counts were frontend 1919.25, frontend-proxy 966.14, recommendation 1.09, and 0 for accounting, ad, checkout, fraud-detection and payment, so ad's own error counter did not rise even though its span output stopped.

recommendation's only error series is span '/flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream' at about 1.11 error spans per 300s both before the deviation (point ending 09:17:52) and during it (point ending 09:38:52), so it is intermittent on both sides of the onset rather than tied to it.

A sampled trace from 09:05:50Z, before the deviation, shows load-generator 'GET' (http.status_code 503) -> frontend-proxy 'ingress' (http.status_code 503, otel.status_code ERROR) -> frontend-proxy 'router frontend egress' (error="true", http.status_code 0) with no frontend span in the trace, establishing that this same 503-on-ingress shape also occurred at a low background rate before the alert.

The repeated JVMChaos injections driven by Schedule otel-demo-ad-jvm-chaos (each run roughly 45–60s, applied to otel-demo/ad-554b849958-fcl25/ad from 09:29:56Z onward and continuously re-applied) are what stopped the ad JVM from serving GetAds: ad's span output drops to zero one minute after the first injection and stays at zero across the schedule's runs, and the frontend error rate stays elevated for as long as the schedule keeps firing.

The ad container's OOMKill (exit 137 at 09:30:21Z, 25 seconds after the first JVMChaos Applied event at 09:29:56Z) may have been produced by a JVM-level fault from that experiment; the kill happened at the container's 450Mi memory limit, but the injected action (latency, exception, GC pressure or memory stress) could not be read, so this link is unverified.

A second, independent candidate for ad not serving is that ad's JVM/heap configuration (450Mi limit against a 225Mi request) is simply undersized for its workload and the OOMKill was capacity-driven rather than injected; the evidence cannot separate these, because post-restart ad logs and any ad error signal are missing.

Rejected: that the ad pod was damaged by being replaced or rolled out — the pod kept the same name ad-554b849958-fcl25 with pod start 08:53:17Z, only its container restarted in place (restartCount 1) after a lastState termination reason of OOMKilled, and the otel-demo events for it are only Pulled/Created/Started for the same pod, with no controller SuccessfulCreate or SuccessfulDelete.

Rejected: that ad was unreachable because of Service/Endpoint misconfiguration or a NetworkPolicy — the ad Service selector and ports are consistent, Endpoints 'ad' contains ad-554b849958-fcl25 at 100.96.4.112:8080, and no NetworkPolicy objects exist in the cluster.

ad itself reported 0 error spans in the incident slice and its pod shows Ready=True; the failure is a loss of ad's span output and serving rather than an error-status signal inside ad, so ad's health cannot be judged from error counters and a passing readiness condition does not contradict the outage.

frontend-proxy and frontend are not the origin: their pods are Running/Ready with restartCount 0, and every frontend-proxy 503 on 'ingress' is accompanied by a failing 'router frontend egress' span toward the frontend, i.e. its own upstream call path, not an internal proxy fault.

Review the chaos-mesh Schedule otel-demo-ad-jvm-chaos (namespace chaos-mesh) and the JVMChaos spec it spawns to identify the injected action and whether it is intended; pausing or removing that schedule is the human action that would stop the recurring injections into ad-554b849958-fcl25.

If OOMKilled recurs once the injections stop, raise ad's 450Mi memory limit or right-size its JVM heap, and re-check ad availability through its span throughput and frontend's grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds error rate.

gaps: The JVMChaos and Schedule custom resources could not be read (those kinds are not in the permitted set), so the injected fault type (latency, exception, GC, memory stress) and its parameters are unknown.

ad's post-restart application logs were not observed: the readable log stream for the current container ends at 2026-11-17T09:30:18.817405901Z, the previous container instance returned HTTP 400 'previous terminated container "ad" ... not found', and that log view was itself incomplete (newest 60 of 2744 matching lines shown), so what the JVM logged after the 09:30:22Z restart is unknown.
The frontend container's logs could not be read (0 lines read, no matching lines), so no application-level error text exists for the /api/data failures.

Jaeger returned no traces for frontend in 09:32–09:42 (two searches returned no_data), and the earlier no_data search for frontend-proxy error traces also returned nothing, so no incident-window trace graph of the 503 -> /api/data -> GetAds chain was obtained; the incident-window chain rests on trace-derived metrics only.

Error-detail fields were empty on the one sampled failing trace, so the exact transport error behind frontend's grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds failures (deadline exceeded versus connection refused) is unknown.
The Prometheus alert rule named RequestErrorRate was not found by list_prometheus_rules (no_data), so the rule's exact expression and label set could not be confirmed from the rule definition.
A query for Pod objects whose name starts with 'ad-' under the Endpoints kind returned nothing, so only the Endpoints object named 'ad' was read; any per-pod EndpointSlice state is unknown.
Whether Schedule otel-demo-ad-jvm-chaos is still active after 09:38:53Z could not be checked, so the present state of the fault injection is unknown.
No change_history integration is available, so no deployment or configuration change record for ad, frontend or frontend-proxy during the window could be checked.
Services that returned no series in the per-service error query (cart, currency, load-generator, product-catalog, quote, shipping, email, image-provider, kafka) are unknown, not zero-error.
Whether ad's readiness probe or service endpoints briefly dropped during the 09:30:21Z container restart could not be observed, because events and object state were read after the fact.
next_steps: Inspect the chaos-mesh Schedule otel-demo-ad-jvm-chaos and its JVMChaos child specs to learn which JVM fault was injected into ad-554b849958-fcl25 and whether the schedule is still active.

After the injections are stopped, verify ad recovery by watching ad's span throughput and frontend's grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds error rate, and confirm frontend-proxy's ingress error rate returns to its pre-09:31 baseline.
Collect ad's post-restart container logs and a fresh incident-window trace of GET /api/data -> grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds to identify the exact gRPC failure mode.
Review ad's memory limit (450Mi) and JVM heap settings if OOMKilled recurs independently of the chaos experiments.
Confirm the RequestErrorRate alert rule definition in the monitoring stack, since the rule was not retrievable in this Run.
